visual_identity.core_identity: The animated skeleton of a minotaur, preserving the horned bull skull and massive humanoid bone structure without flesh.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall skeletal humanoid frame topped by a broad horned bull skull, large rib cage, long bones, and heavy feet.
visual_identity.head_features: Large bovine skull with long muzzle cavity, empty eye sockets, and prominent curved horns.
visual_identity.body_shape: Heavy humanoid skeleton with broad rib cage and large limb bones, clearly larger than a human skeleton.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Two skeletal arms and two skeletal legs beneath a bull skull; hooved skeletal lower anatomy where readable.
visual_identity.surface: Clean bone shapes with sparse cracks, no gore or hanging flesh.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Wide grounded skeletal stance with deliberate weight and horn-forward threat.

known_failure_modes.correction: restore elongated bovine skull and large curved horns
show clean exposed skeleton throughout the body
